summary: Full forensic analysis of 9 old PYQ papers (3161919) mapped against the new 3-chapter progressive assessment syllabus (BE05019021) for Energy Conservation and Management. Contains syllabus boundary verification, danger zones of out-of-scope topics, topic frequency tables with tier classifications, two study strategies (20/30 and 25/30 marks), key formulas for boiler efficiency indirect method numerical, and honest assessment of gaps and risks.
